ta_read.text: QQQ's daily swings show lower highs and lower lows; the last structure break was down on Nov 24, when it closed below $647.05. On weekly bars it is in a downtrend (below its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show mixed swings (a range).

The nearest support zone is $644.39–$649.71, where price turned 1 times, most recently on Nov 5; the nearest resistance zone is $659.11–$664.43, where price turned 2 times, most recently on Jul 29, a former support that flipped to resistance.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 9 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 3 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (+2.7%) came on light volume.
RSI is 44 (neutral); MACD is below its signal line since Oct 13.
A daily close above $664.43 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $644.39 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
